process_area.title: Emergency Material Allocation, Disaster Kit Assembly & Staging Operations

value_stream.name: Disaster Relief Supply Chain Logistics & Humanitarian Aid Coordination

fields.Owner: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)
fields.Participants: Category Managers (VS-01), Logistics Manager (VS-06), DC Operations (VS-04)
fields.Trigger: Start of typhoon season (Q2); weather bureau PAGASA tracking major storm warning
fields.Volume: Staging plan covering 4 regional DCs and 200 stores

workflows.name: Disaster Relief Supply Forecasting & Category Inventory Staging Plan

Automation Opportunity: - Storm-path mapping overlay on ERP warehouse inventory maps.
Controls: - CTL-770 (ensure controlled execution — Emergency Material Allocation, Disaster Kit Assembly & Staging Operations (PA-180.1).)
- CTL-770: Staging Plan approved by VP Supply Chain; safety stock thresholds configured in ERP.
Cross-references: - links to VS-02 (supply planning), VS-127 (S&OP), VS-06 (logistics), VS-04 (DC ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-stocking / Dead stock**: Staged inventory unsold if storm shifts; mitigated by focusing staging on high-velocity standard SKUs (e.g. cement, nails) that sell under normal operations.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Replenishment module (VS-02), S&OP database (VS-127), weather data interface.

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)
steps.activity: Analyze historic storm tracks and geographic store vulnerabilities (e.g. East Coast Luzon, Visayas).
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)
steps.activity: Model relief demand: forecast quantity spikes for galvanized iron (GI) roof sheets, plywood, nails, cement, flashlights, batteries, and portable generators.
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)
steps.activity: Draft the Disaster Staging Plan: define inventory reserve targets for safety stock levels at DC hubs (Mindanao, Visayas, Luzon).
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)
steps.activity: Execute inventory stock transfers to pre-position forecasted SKUs at regional DCs prior to landfall.
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain Planning / S&OP Manager (VS-127)

fields.Owner: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner
fields.Participants: DC Manager (VS-04), Category Buyers (VS-03), Store Managers
fields.Trigger: LGU State of Calamity declaration; high supply constraints post-landfall

workflows.name: Emergency Building Materials (Galvanized Sheets, Nails, Lumber) Priority Allocation

Automation Opportunity: - Rule-based inventory allocation engine routing stock to stores in disaster zones.
Controls: - CTL-770 (ensure controlled execution — Emergency Material Allocation, Disaster Kit Assembly & Staging Operations (PA-180.1).)
- CTL-770: Allocation adjustments require sign-off from Director of Inventory; changes audited.
Cross-references: - links to VS-04 (DC ops), VS-03 (procurement), VS-60 (order routing), VS-03.2 (PO cycle)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stock hoarding by unaffected stores**: Unaffected branches buying up stock; mitigated by centralized inventory locks blocking store-initiated transfers.
System Touchpoints: - WMS allocation screen (VS-04), Purchase order portal (VS-03.2), order routing engine (VS-60).

steps.a: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner
steps.activity: Identify depleted relief SKUs and aggregate outstanding backorders from affected stores.
steps.r: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner

steps.a: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner
steps.activity: Implement ERP inventory lock: reserve incoming and existing stocks of GI sheets, lumber, and fasteners at DCs for disaster regions.
steps.r: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner

steps.a: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner
steps.activity: Apply allocation rules: distribute stock based on LGU damage severity ratings (NDRRMC briefs) and store waitlists.
steps.r: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner

steps.a: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner
steps.activity: Coordinate fast-track PO release to local building material manufacturers (VS-03) with emergency lead times.
steps.r: Director of Inventory Management / Supply Chain Planner

fields.Participants: Kitting Associates, Packaging team (VS-111), Procurement, CSR (VS-152)
fields.Trigger: Disaster Staging Plan activation (W5177); NGO partner request

workflows.name: Disaster Relief Home Rebuilding Kit Kitting & Staging

Controls: - CTL-770 (ensure controlled execution — Emergency Material Allocation, Disaster Kit Assembly & Staging Operations (PA-180.1).)
- CTL-770: Kit weight checked on exit scale; completed kits inspected by DC QA supervisor.
Cross-references: - links to VS-92 (kitting), VS-111 (packaging), VS-04 (DC ops), VS-152 (CSR)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Kit component bottlenecks**: Missing single tool delaying entire kit assembly; mitigated by substituting equivalent brands or tools from retail stock.
System Touchpoints: - WMS kitting module (VS-04), Bill of Materials database (VS-92), Packaging standards database (VS-111).

steps.a: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Define Bill of Materials (BOM) for the 'BuildRight Home Rebuilding Kit' (e.g. 10 GI sheets, 3 pcs lumber, 5kg nails, hammer, handsaw, tarpaulin).
steps.r: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)

steps.a: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Set up the kitting line in DC staging zones: configure workspaces, arrange packaging crates, and stage components.
steps.r: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)

steps.a: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Execute kit assembly: pick components, bundle lumber/sheets, pack hand tools, and shrink-wrap the consolidated kit (VS-92).
steps.r: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)

steps.a: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Label kits with barcodes, technical descriptions, and safety instructions; stage in outbound lane for dispatch.
steps.r: DC Operations Manager (VS-04)

fields.Owner: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer
fields.Trigger: Typhoon track warning indicating category 3+ storm heading to grid-vulnerable areas

workflows.name: Emergency Power Generator & Solar Portable Kit Pre-Positioning

Controls: - CTL-770 (ensure controlled execution — Emergency Material Allocation, Disaster Kit Assembly & Staging Operations (PA-180.1).)
- CTL-770: Serial numbers of pre-positioned units recorded in transfer documents; receipts signed by Store Manager and LP officer.
Cross-references: - links to VS-70 (solar energy), VS-23 (loss prevention), VS-04 (DC ops), VS-120 (energy compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stolen / Missing generators**: High theft risk post-storm; mitigated by locking generators in store cash vaults or secure cages.
System Touchpoints: - WMS transfer system (VS-04), Store LP system (VS-23), ESG energy tracker (VS-120).

steps.a: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer
steps.activity: Identify power-vulnerable stores in the storm path: check historical power outage logs and flood zones.
steps.r: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer

steps.a: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer
steps.activity: Calculate emergency power stock: allocate 5kW-10kW generators for store backup power, and portable 1kW solar generator/battery kits for retail sale.
steps.r: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer

steps.a: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer
steps.activity: Coordinate fast-track transfer from primary DC to store backrooms; verify pre-positioning is complete 24 hours before landfall.
steps.r: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer

steps.a: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer
steps.activity: Instruct store LP on security protocols for high-value generator staging zones (VS-23).
steps.r: Solar & Renewable Product Manager (VS-70) / Category Buyer

fields.Participants: Shift Supervisors, Forklift Operators, Inventory Clerk
fields.Trigger: Landfall + storm damage reports; urgent store replenishment requests (W5178)

workflows.name: DC Emergency Staging Zone Allocation & Fast-Track Pick Operations

Controls: - CTL-770: Gate-pass security check matches loaded items to emergency manifest; deviations flagged.
Pain Points / Risks: - **DC gridlock**: Regular store deliveries block emergency vehicles; mitigated by pausing standard deliveries and dedicating Docks 1-4 exclusively to relief logistics.
System Touchpoints: - WMS staging screen (VS-04), ERP logistics dispatch (VS-06).
Time Estimate: - ~30-45 mins per truckload pick and stage

steps.a: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Clear designated Outbound Emergency Staging Zones near DC shipping docks.
steps.r: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)

steps.a: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Release emergency wave picking: prioritize picking of relief kits (W5179), structural timber, cement, and water containers.
steps.r: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)

steps.a: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Configure warehouse routes: assign dedicated forklift drivers to transport relief materials to the emergency staging zone.
steps.r: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)

steps.a: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)
steps.activity: Scan and verify loaded pallets against dispatch documents; coordinate driver signature and vehicle gate-pass.
steps.r: DC Warehouse Manager (VS-04)

fields.Participants: Local Vendors (cement, roofing, water), Store Managers, AP Finance (VS-15)
fields.Trigger: DC stockouts of critical relief items; direct shipping viable from local vendor plant to store

workflows.name: Emergency Vendor Direct-to-Store Delivery (DSD) Fast-Track PO Issuance

Automation Opportunity: - Supplier portal direct notification of emergency POs.
Controls: - CTL-770: PO matched to store-receiving logs; variance audit on billing price before payment release.
Cross-references: - links to VS-03 (procurement), VS-15 (P2P), VS-03.2 (PO cycle), VS-03.4 (vendor portal), VS-07.3 (store receiving)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vendor charging inflated prices**: Violation of price freezes; mitigated by pre-negotiated emergency price sheets stored in the ERP vendor master.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Purchase Order module (VS-03.2), Vendor portal (VS-03.4), Store receiving (VS-07.3).

steps.a: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)
steps.activity: Identify local vendors with active plants near affected stores (avoiding DC transit).
steps.r: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)

steps.a: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)
steps.activity: Draft emergency DSD PO: define quantities, delivery store, and agreed emergency pricing (complying with price freezes).
steps.r: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)

steps.a: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)
steps.activity: Route PO through the ERP fast-track approval workflow: bypass standard category manager queue if emergency limits apply.
steps.r: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)

steps.a: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)
steps.activity: Coordinate delivery slot with store manager; receive goods at store, verify counts, and scan delivery receipts into ERP.
steps.r: Procurement Operations Manager (VS-03)

fields.Participants: Shipping Lines (e.g. 2GO, Chelsea), Port Authority, Customs Compliance (VS-87)
fields.Trigger: Disaster staging plan activation (W5177); Luzon/NCR DC supplying Visayas/Mindanao stores

workflows.name: Inter-Island Relief Freight Capacity Reservation & Shipping Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - GPS track of shipping transit linked to control tower dashboard.
Controls: - CTL-770 (ensure controlled execution — Emergency Material Allocation, Disaster Kit Assembly & Staging Operations (PA-180.1).)
- CTL-770: Bills of Lading matched to dispatch manifests; port fees approved by Logistics controller.
Cross-references: - links to VS-06 (logistics), VS-87 (customs), VS-110 (freight procurement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Port closure due to weather**: Sea travel suspended, blocking deliveries; mitigated by staging inventory on land at both sides of sea lanes.
System Touchpoints: - Logistics control tower (W250), Shipping line scheduling system, Port authority portal.

steps.a: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)
steps.activity: Assess inter-island ferry/vessel status in storm path; identify available Ro-Ro (Roll-on/Roll-off) or container slots.
steps.r: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)

steps.a: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)
steps.activity: Negotiate emergency space allocation: secure priority shipping slots for BuildRight relief trucks.
steps.r: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)

steps.a: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)
steps.activity: Coordinate port documents: prepare bill of lading, barangay clearance, and LGU emergency certifications to bypass port queues.
steps.r: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)

steps.a: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)
steps.activity: Track container shipment status and coordinate destination port receiving with local logistics teams.
steps.r: Outbound Logistics Manager / Freight Broker (VS-06)

fields.Owner: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)
fields.Participants: Drivers, LGU Road Officials, DPWH (Public Works)
fields.Trigger: Post-landfall road clearance reports; relief dispatch preparation

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time mapping overlay of road blocks on fleet routing software.
Controls: - CTL-770 (ensure controlled execution — Emergency Material Allocation, Disaster Kit Assembly & Staging Operations (PA-180.1).)
- CTL-770: Driver route plans approved by Fleet Supervisor; satellite check-in schedules established.
Cross-references: - links to VS-06 (logistics), VS-110 (freight procurement), VS-159 (corporate security)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Truck stuck in flood / Hijack**: Delivery stranded or looted in remote areas; mitigated by coordinating police/military escorts for high-value relief loads.
System Touchpoints: - Logistics control tower (W250), GPS tracking system, route optimization software.

steps.a: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)
steps.activity: Monitor road closures: collect reports from DPWH, local news, and regional store managers.
steps.r: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)

steps.a: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)
steps.activity: Determine optimized route: use navigation tools to bypass flooded roads, collapsed bridges, and landslide zones.
steps.r: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)

steps.a: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)
steps.activity: Brief drivers: provide route maps, emergency LGU contacts, satellite phones, and road-clearance credentials.
steps.r: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)

steps.a: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)
steps.activity: Monitor truck GPS in real-time; coordinate backup routes if drivers report unexpected blockages.
steps.r: Fleet Planner / Logistics Control Tower Lead (VS-06)
